title: Summation of the telescoping series of deformed shells (Simon 6.5.1, (17)–(25))
statement: Summation of a telescoping series of deformed shells (Simon Ch. 6, proof of 5.1, displays (17)–(25)). Assume, as a hypothesis of the statement, (VO): the frozen type of Submission.dtc_vanish_off_support (for all P, n, U, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U), S(ω) = 0 whenever tsupport ω is disjoint from spt S). Let P, m ∈ ℕ and assume (S-i): for every closed E ⊆ ℝ^P and every X ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) (domain univ) such that X(ω) = 0 for every ω ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) whose tsupport is disjoint from E, spt X ⊆ E (conjunct (i), in degree m, of the frozen type of Submission.cmcsd_support_calculus, taken as a hypothesis); assume also (IMS), the conclusion of the frozen type of Submission.cmcdt_im_series for this P (taken verbatim as a hypothesis): for every k ∈ ℕ and all W_i ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^P) (i ∈ ℕ, domain univ) with Σ_i M(W_i) < ∞ (tsum in [0, ∞]) there is S ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^P) such that: for every test form ω, the series Σ_i W_i(ω) has sum S(ω) (HasSum); M(S) ≤ Σ_i M(W_i); spt S ⊆ closure(⋃_i spt W_i); and if every W_i is integer multiplicity then S is integer multiplicity. Let T ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P), and for j ∈ ℕ let W_j, V_j, E′_j, K_j ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P), H_j ∈ 𝒟_{m+2}(ℝ^P), Y_j, L′_j ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) (all on univ); let a, b, c : ℕ → [0, ∞], δ ∈ ℝ and K₁, K₂, K₃ ⊆ ℝ^P. Assume: Σ_j W_j(ω) = T(ω) (HasSum) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^{m+1}(ℝ^P); (I1) W_0 − V_0 − (E′_0 − K_0) = ∂H_0; (I2) W_{j+1} − V_{j+1} − (E′_{j+1} − (K_{j+1} − K_j)) = ∂H_{j+1} for all j; (I3) ∂V_0 = Y_0 − L′_0; (I4) ∂V_{j+1} = Y_{j+1} − (L′_{j+1} − L′_j) for all j; V_j and H_j are integer multiplicity for all j; for all j, M(V_j) ≤ a_j, M(H_j) ≤ δ·a_j, M(Y_j) ≤ b_j, M(E′_j) ≤ δ·b_j, M(L′_j) ≤ c_j and M(K_j) ≤ δ·c_j (δ read as ENNReal.ofReal δ); Σ_j a_j < ∞, Σ_j b_j < ∞ and c_j → 0 in [0, ∞]; K₁, K₂, K₃ are closed; for all j, spt V_j ⊆ K₁, spt H_j ⊆ K₂, spt Y_j ⊆ K₃ and spt E′_j ⊆ K₃. Then there are Q₀ ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P), R₁ ∈ 𝒟_{m+2}(ℝ^P) and S₁ ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) with: Q₀ and R₁ integer multiplicity; T − Q₀ − S₁ = ∂R₁; spt Q₀ ⊆ K₁, spt R₁ ⊆ K₂, spt ∂Q₀ ⊆ K₃, spt S₁ ⊆ K₃; M(Q₀) ≤ Σ_j a_j, M(∂Q₀) ≤ Σ_j b_j, M(R₁) ≤ δ·Σ_j a_j and M(S₁) ≤ δ·Σ_j b_j. Conventions: ℝ^P = Euclid P (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P)); for U ⊆ ℝ^P, 𝒟^k(U) = TestFormOn U k (smooth k-forms on ℝ^P whose compact tsupport lies in U) and 𝒟_k(U) = GeometricCurrentOn U k (SimonGMT Chapter06), X(ω) the value of X on ω; X − Y is the contract subtraction, (X − Y)(ω) = X(ω) − Y(ω) (definitional); ∂X = X.boundary, ∂X(η) = X(dη) (GeometricCurrentOn.boundary_apply, dη = exteriorDerivativeTestOn U k η, whose underlying form is exteriorDerivative η); currents are equal when their values agree (GeometricCurrentOn.ext). |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α is the Euclidean coefficient norm of a covector. M_G(X) = X.massOn G ∈ [0, ∞] is the supremum of ENNReal.ofReal X(ω) over the ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ G and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x (such ω are admissible for M_G, massAdmissibleOn U k G); M(X) = X.mass = M_U(X); boundaryMassOn X G = M_G(∂X) if k ≥ 1 and 0 if k = 0. spt X = X.support (Simon 6.2.11) = U minus the zero region, the union of the open W with compact closure contained in U on which X vanishes (X(ω) = 0 whenever tsupport ω ⊆ W). IM = IsIntegerMultiplicity: X is represented by an IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) of the contract, i.e. X(ω) = R.action ω = ∫_M θ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dHⁿ. Metric.cthickening δ E = {x : infEdist x E ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ}; in a mass bound, a real factor δ is read as ENNReal.ofReal δ.
